# SYNESIS_E020 — Error

## Description

Required field `field_name` missing in ITEM block.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field `field_name` is required in this ITEM block,
  but it was not found.
  Add the line `field_name: <value>` to the block before
  `END ITEM`.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MissingRequiredField**: `field_name`, `block_type`
